svg.text: Raising the house does not yet make a terminal accessible
30 October 2026 / RWT-06 sensitivity / 220 mm catalogue-informed transverse envelope / not for construction
A Exterior-interface comparison: old fixed grade; vertical scale 1:5
House raise 435; downward travel 50 (sensitivity only)
Fixed old grade / comparison access plane
Underside plane only; footprint unproved
85 initial upper gap: unchanged by raise
After travel: 55 below plane
Initial flange already penetrates plane by 5.
House raise 550; downward travel 50 (sensitivity only)
Fixed old grade / comparison access plane
Underside plane only; footprint unproved
85 initial upper gap: unchanged by raise
After travel: 60 above plane
60 nominal gap after travel; no complete access pass.
B Necessary section bound, not an adopted building height
Flange nonpenetration: raise >= 440 + b + g + s
b downward release; g specified gap; s access-plane rise. All in millimetres.
Combined historical comparison: raise >= max(435 + p, 440 + b + g + s).
p is receiving-event rise above old grade; 435 retains the OLD receiver condition only.
g = 0 at equality means contact. No required b, g or safe access height is known.
A 100 extension along the old slope changes contact raise to 441.412.
Raising house AND access plane equally produces no relative gain.
C Constraints that a house raise does not remove
Near / far initial upper gaps: 25 / 85.
Near and far are historical slices y7750 / y12000.
220 intact flange still cannot traverse a 160 bore.
Two flanges at 400 centres occupy 620.
Old 650 aperture leaves only 15 per side.
Retaining 35 side allowances needs 690 before walls.
Whole terminal, tools, supports and access remain unknown.
One transverse envelope, not axial fitting width. Access plane overlaps the full tested sweep; a real edge requires a different check.
Red dash shows the downward component only; away travel is omitted. No full removal path, elbow, second flange or person is drawn.
The old 435 raise is rejected as an automatic copper-access solution. Develop the located section and actual release before selection.
Sources, pinning, sensitivities and admission limits: raised-terminal-section.md and the companion generated JSON.
